title: TwinBench: Multi-Fidelity Benchmarking for Controller Selection in 6-DOF Industrial Manipulators
description: Code, data and scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the TwinBench paper: four controllers (PD+g, CTC-PD, CTC-SMC, PBC) on six 6-DOF industrial manipulators, three datasheet robots at a decoupled proxy tier and three URDF robots at both the proxy and a Pinocchio rigid-body tier, under three parametric uncertainty levels. The robot descriptions in urdf_models/ are third-party files under their upstream BSD and Apache-2.0 licenses.
